description.value:
You house the dead who are closer to raging than any sane broker would recommend — the murdered, the starved, the ones who died mid-scream and never finished. Ferociously powerful. Ferociously unstable. Everyone else in the trade will ask you why.

  • Borrowed Grief: Unveiled, you can channel the spirit's dying moment directly into a foe — fear, agony, the specific horror of how it ended.
  • Overdraw as a Way of Life: your Toll ceiling is higher and your Fraying die is nastier — you're built to push past what's fair on purpose, more often than the other two Covenants can safely manage.
  • Every Wailing Debt spirit is one bad week from becoming exactly the kind of raging spirit the Spirit-Wardens get called in to put down. You know this. You keep doing it anyway.
